answer_1.quote: Our novel model, Expression-Pointer Transformer with Explanations (EPT-X), ... generates explanations for each number/variable separately ...
answer_1.outputs: natural language explanations for numbers/variables and algebraic solution equations

answer_2.quote: To test the plausibility of explanations, we used BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, CIDEr, and BLEURT ... For faithfulness we measured changes using tree edit distance.

answer_4.quote: Human coders were asked to label an explanation to be plausible when the explanation and the original problem text are coherent ... For faithfulness, we asked human coders to build a solution equation using only the explanation produced from the EPT-X model.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each generated explanation for (1) plausibility (coherence with the problem) and (2) faithfulness (whether the same equation can be derived from the explanation).
